<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="release-process">
<h1>Release process</h1>
<p>This document describes how to build, validate, and publish a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code>
release. The release gate is the clean-wheel smoke test in
<a class="reference download internal" download="" href="../_downloads/d2e023c576079cfdbed6ee568251268b/smoke_wheel.py"><span class="xref download myst"><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">scripts/smoke_wheel.py</span></code></span></a> executed against a
wheel installed in a fresh virtualenv.</p>
<section id="prerequisites">
<h2>Prerequisites</h2>
<p>Install build and validation tools:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.[dev,docs,release]&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># or, equivalently:</span>
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;.[dev]&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>twine
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hatch-vcs</span></code> for versioning. Installing or building the
project generates a gitignored <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore/_version.py</span></code> that exposes
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore.__version__</span></code>; do not commit that file. Direct source-tree imports
fall back to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0.0.0+unknown</span></code> when that generated module is absent, and a
matching <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore/_version.pyi</span></code> ships with the package so strict mypy
passes in a pristine source tree.</p>
</section>
<section id="pre-release-checklist">
<h2>Pre-release checklist</h2>
<ol class="arabic">
<li><p>Ensure all tests pass:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>-q
</pre></div>
</div>
</li>
<li><p>Ensure lint is clean:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>ruff<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>.
</pre></div>
</div>
</li>
<li><p>Ensure type checking passes in a pristine source tree. The generated
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_version.py</span></code> is removed first so the documented source-tree fallback is
actually exercised:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>rm<span class="w"> </span>-f<span class="w"> </span>ledgercore/_version.py
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>mypy<span class="w"> </span>ledgercore
</pre></div>
</div>
</li>
<li><p>Ensure formatting and documentation are clean. The Sphinx build no longer
requires network access; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.ext.intersphinx</span></code> is disabled because no
cross-project Python references are used yet.</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>ruff<span class="w"> </span>format<span class="w"> </span>--check<span class="w"> </span>.
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>sphinx<span class="w"> </span>-W<span class="w"> </span>-b<span class="w"> </span>html<span class="w"> </span>docs<span class="w"> </span>docs/_build/html
</pre></div>
</div>
</li>
<li><p>Ensure the three example scripts run from the source tree:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nv">PYTHONPATH</span><span class="o">=</span>.<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>examples/frontmatter.py
<span class="nv">PYTHONPATH</span><span class="o">=</span>.<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>examples/refs.py
<span class="nv">PYTHONPATH</span><span class="o">=</span>.<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>examples/storage.py
</pre></div>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="building">
<h2>Building</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>build
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Builds from a non-git source archive are supported when the intended version
is provided explicitly. Use a placeholder for repeatable local runs:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nv">SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION</span><span class="o">=</span>X.Y.Z<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>build
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>For an actual 0.4.0 release build, use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0.4.0</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nv">SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="m">0</span>.4.0<span class="w"> </span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>build
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>This produces <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dist/ledgercore-&lt;version&gt;.tar.gz</span></code> and
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">dist/ledgercore-&lt;version&gt;-py3-none-any.whl</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="validating-the-distribution">
<h2>Validating the distribution</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>twine<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>dist/*
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="smoke-testing-required-release-gate">
<h2>Smoke testing (required release gate)</h2>
<p>Install the built wheel into a clean virtualenv and run the release smoke
script. The script exercises a representative slice of the public API so that
packaging regressions (missing modules, lost data files, broken imports)
surface before publishing. Use a writable location for the venv; on some
platforms <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">/tmp</span></code> is not writable. Run the script from a working directory
that does not shadow the installed package:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nv">smoke_dir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="k">$(</span><span class="nb">pwd</span><span class="k">)</span><span class="s2">/.smoke&quot;</span>
rm<span class="w"> </span>-rf<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>venv<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
<span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">/bin/python&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="k">$(</span><span class="nb">echo</span><span class="w"> </span>dist/*.whl<span class="k">)</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
<span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$smoke_dir</span><span class="s2">/bin/python&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>scripts/smoke_wheel.py
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The script must print <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span> <span class="pre">0.4.0</span> <span class="pre">smoke</span> <span class="pre">test</span> <span class="pre">passed</span></code> and exit 0. The
source-tree smoke test (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tests/test_smoke_wheel_source.py</span></code>) covers the same
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">main()</span></code> function and must also pass in CI.</p>
</section>
<section id="artifact-content-verification">
<h2>Artifact content verification</h2>
<p>Verify the wheel and sdist ship the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LICENSE</span></code> file, the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">py.typed</span></code> marker,
and the generated <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore/_version.py</span></code>:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-<span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&lt;&lt;&#39;PY&#39;</span>
<span class="s">import glob, tarfile, zipfile</span>

<span class="s">wheel = glob.glob(&quot;dist/*.whl&quot;)[0]</span>
<span class="s">sdist = glob.glob(&quot;dist/*.tar.gz&quot;)[0]</span>

<span class="s">with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:</span>
<span class="s">    names = archive.namelist()</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;LICENSE&quot;) for name in names)</span>
<span class="s">    assert &quot;ledgercore/_version.py&quot; in names</span>
<span class="s">    assert &quot;ledgercore/py.typed&quot; in names</span>

<span class="s">with tarfile.open(sdist) as archive:</span>
<span class="s">    names = archive.getnames()</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;/LICENSE&quot;) for name in names)</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;/ledgercore/_version.py&quot;) for name in names)</span>
<span class="s">    assert any(name.endswith(&quot;/ledgercore/py.typed&quot;) for name in names)</span>

<span class="s">print(&quot;artifact check passed&quot;)</span>
<span class="s">PY</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>

</pre></div>

<section id="version-policy">
<h2>Version policy</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore</span></code> is pre-1.0. Patch releases preserve the current minor API where
practical. Minor releases may intentionally evolve public APIs before 1.0,
with changelog and migration guidance. The 0.4.0 release adds the fixed
sibling-ledger workspace convention while preserving namespaced root overrides.</p>
</section>

<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
